entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: A death-defying interplanar circuit race and the Multiverse's premier combat sporting event, begun as an illegal street race on Avishkar.

entities.name: Ghirapur Sprint
entities.description: An illicit nighttime street race held by the New Culture Collective that the Grand Prix grew out of.

entities.name: New Culture Collective
entities.description: A countercultural movement from Ghirapur that organized the Sprint and became a major political party after the Indigo Revolution.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The old Avishkari government that tried to shut down the Sprint and whose former members launched a coup during the second Grand Prix.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: The new night minister of Ghirapur who oversees the Grand Prix's independent governing body.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane where the Grand Prix began and where it starts and ends.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Avishkar where the race starts, ends and is broadcast.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane crossed by the second Grand Prix, along the Luxa and the boiling desert.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A primordial jungle plane crossed by the second Grand Prix, with giant dinosaurs and Saurid raiders.

entities.name: Saurid Autocracy
entities.description: A ruling power of Muraganda that gave assurances to the Avishkari delegations.

entities.name: Cloudspire Racing Team
entities.description: Kylem's team, which won the inaugural Grand Prix.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: The racing team captained by Zahur that won the second Grand Prix.

entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: Captain of the Champions of Amonkhet who reached the finish line first in the second Grand Prix.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: An artifact containing a planeswalker's spark, offered as the second Grand Prix's grand prize.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who mind controlled several racers in an attempt to recover Loot during the second Grand Prix.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A being Jace Beleren tried to recover during the race.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker rendered unconscious by Jace during the second Grand Prix.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A character rendered unconscious by Jace during the second Grand Prix.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: A character rendered unconscious by Jace during the second Grand Prix.

entities.name: Indigo Revolution
entities.description: The revolution on Avishkar after which the NCC became a major political party.

entities.name: Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: The new government that sought to expand the Grand Prix across the Multiverse.

events.summary: The Grand Prix begins decades before the New Phyrexian Invasion as the Ghirapur Sprint, an illicit street race held annually by the New Culture Collective.
events.quote: It was held at night annually by the New Culture Collective , a countercultural movement from Ghirapur.

events.summary: The Consulate spends great resources trying to shut down the race and imprison the NCC's leaders.
events.quote: The Consulate spent great resources attempting to shut down the race and imprison the NCC's leaders, and was successful for some years.

events.summary: After the NCC becomes a major political party following the Indigo Revolution, the race is proposed as a tool of soft power.
events.quote: When the NCC became a major political party after Avishkar's Indigo Revolution , the race was proposed as a tool of soft power

events.summary: The chaotic inaugural Grand Prix, the first multiplanar race, crosses nearly two dozen planes; some teams are killed or lost, and Kylem's Cloudspire Racing Team wins.
events.quote: Kylem's team, the Cloudspire Racing Team , won this edition.

events.summary: The Avishkar Assembly expands the event beyond Avishkar to invite teams from many planes as an annual festival.
events.quote: the Avishkar Assembly sought to expand the event beyond the borders of Ghirapur and Avishkar itself

events.summary: The second interplanar Grand Prix is held around 4564 AR across Amonkhet and Muraganda with the Aetherspark as grand prize.
events.quote: The Aetherspark , an artifact that contained a planeswalker's spark , was offered as the race's grand prize.

events.summary: The race crosses Amonkhet and Muraganda, where racers are hindered by giant dinosaurs and Saurid raiders, before returning to Ghirapur.
events.quote: Their progress was also hindered by attacks from giant dinosaur and Saurid raiders.

events.summary: All teams reach the final stage despite hazards and a dragonstorm, but a revanchist coup by former Consulate members traps many racers.
events.quote: a revanchist coup launched by former Consulate members impeded many of the racers.

events.summary: Jace Beleren mind controls several racers in an attempt to recover Loot and knocks out Chandra, Pia Nalaar and Sita Varma.
events.quote: were mind controlled by Jace Beleren in an attempt to recover Loot , while he rendered Chandra and Pia Nalaar and Sita Varma unconscious.

events.summary: In the confusion, Zahur of the Champions of Amonkhet crosses the finish line first and wins the Aetherspark.
events.quote: Zahur , captain of the Champions of Amonkhet , reached the finish line first, winning the Aetherspark for his team.

relations.quote: Zahur , captain of the Champions of Amonkhet , reached the finish line first
